samples.before: Deleting your account permanently removes the account and its data after a waiting period. Dosya shows a review before it sends the confirmation code, so you can copy data and resolve workspace ownership first. ## Before you start - Download any files, billing records or account information you need to keep. - Check every workspace you own. A workspace with other members blocks deletion until you transfer ownership or remove those members. - If you only want to stop a paid plan or leave one workspace, use that workspace's billing or membership controls instead. - Keep access to your account email. Dosya sends a six-digit confirmation code there. - Do not begin while important uploads, transfers or downloads are still running. ## Steps: review and schedule account deletion 1. Sign in to Dosya and open **Profile**. 2. Select **Delete account**. 3. Review the deletion summary. Check the number of owned workspaces, files, the waiting period and any blockers. 4. If Dosya lists a workspace blocker, open that workspace and transfer ownership or remove its remaining members. Return to the deletion page and refresh the review. 5. Select the option to request the confirmation code. 6. Open the message sent to your account email and enter its six-digit code. A code expires, so request a new one if it is no longer accepted. 7. Confirm the deletion request. Dosya schedules deletion and signs you out.
